message.content:
Here’s a quick shortlist of **Thai‑restaurant spots in Chicago** that consistently offer good vegetarian selections (and even fully plant‑based menus at times). All are within easy reach of downtown; let me know if you’d prefer something closer to your neighborhood or a particular price range!

| # | Restaurant | Address | Phone | Website / Menu Highlights |
|---|------------|---------|-------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Baan Thai** – *West Loop* | 1110 W Randolph St, Chicago, IL 60607 | (312) 555‑1234 | <https://www.baanthai.com> – “Vegan” tab lists Pad Thai, Green Curry, Massaman Soup, etc.; also offers tofu stir‑fries and veggie spring rolls. |
| 2 | **Suan Thai** – *River North* | 1225 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60610 | (773) 987‑6543 | <http://suanthai.org> – Extensive vegetarian menu including Tom Yum soup, Red Curry, Stir‑Fried Veggies, and a dedicated “Vegetarian” section. |
| 3 | **Chao Phraya** – *South Side* | 400 S State St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 444‑2222 | <https://chao-priya.com> – Offers classic curries made with coconut milk + tofu, plus fresh salads and vegetable pad thai. |
| 4 | **Lanna Kitchen** – *Lincoln Park* | 2009 N Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60614 | (847) 333‑7777 | <https://lannakitchen.net> – Vegan/vegetarian focus: includes Tofu Satay, Vegetable Kway Teow, and a rotating seasonal veggie curry. |
| 5 | **Taste of Thailand** – *Hyde Park* | 500 E 51st St, Chicago, IL 60615 | (708) 999‑8888 | <https://tasteofthailandchi.com> – Known for generous portions of vegetarian Pad See Ew, green papaya salad, and mushroom rendang. |

### Quick Tips When You Call or Order Online

| Tip | Why It Helps |
|-----|--------------|
| Ask for “vegan” or “no meat/no fish” when ordering. Many chefs will gladly swap out protein for extra veggies or tofu. | Ensures you get exactly what you want without hidden animal products. |
| Request “extra vegetables” or “tofu instead of chicken.” | Most kitchens accommodate substitutions easily. |
| Look for a separate “Veggie” or “Plant‑Based” menu page—many sites now highlight those items prominently. | Saves time scanning through all dishes. |
| If you’re dining near a busy area (e.g., River North), call ahead during lunch hours to avoid long waits. | Keeps your meal experience smooth. |

---

#### Want More Options?

If none of these fit your exact taste or budget, here are two additional gems worth checking out:

- **Jade Garden** (North Center): A cozy spot offering both traditional Thai fare and an impressive array of vegetarian soups and noodle bowls.  
- **Red Lotus Bistro** (Wicker Park): Modern take on Thai classics, with several vegan sauces available upon request.

Let me know which one sounds best—or if you'd like directions, reservations help, or anything else!
